color-system.twistDescription: Copied verbatim — no modification. color_register_actual: light (pageBackground #fcf7f1 luminance ≈ 248, well above 190 threshold).

type-system.twistDescription: Twist B (letter spacing injection): added --font-letter-spacing-heading: 0.06em applied to all heading levels. Both Fraunces and Inter confirmed in Google Fonts list; CDN @import used. No woff2 references.

motion-system.twistDescription: Twist E (delay introduction): 0.1s stagger delay between sequenced animation items added. Primary duration retained at 0.4s, fast interaction at 0.2s. Easing: cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) throughout.

grid-system.twistDescription: Twist A (container max-width tightening): reduced from 1440px to 1224px (~15% reduction, editorial proportion). Breakpoints preserved at bp-820px and bp-1075px.

spacing-system.twistDescription: Twist C (hero padding emphasis): hero paddingTop and paddingBottom scaled ×1.5 from 69.12px to 103.68px. All other spacing values unchanged.

interaction-states.twistDescription: Twist E (focus state enhancement): outlineWidth 2px, outlineStyle solid, outlineOffset 2px added to focus states for buttons, inputs, links, and navigation. No color values changed.

nav-system.twistDescription: Twist D (letter spacing on nav links): added typography.letterSpacing: 0.08em — intensity 3 value. Pill hover states and compact height (30px) retained from source.

concept-summary.twistDescription: Twist C (material shift): added physical materiality detail to the color register paragraph — specifically the pebble-and-shore metaphor and tactile surface quality of the warm cream + black + navy palette. concept_by_video.md generated fresh with three video placements: hero-bg.mp4 (macro material surface drift, 10s), materials-ambient.mp4 (craft components with directional light, 5s), context-ambient.mp4 (atmospheric place/environment, 5s).

consistencyChecks.colorContrast: PASS — navText #000000 on transparent (cream) is high contrast; bodyText #000000 on #fcf7f1 is high contrast
consistencyChecks.motionInteractionCoherence: PASS — hover 0.2s vs motion 0.4s is 2× ratio, well within 5× threshold
consistencyChecks.navFontAvailability: PASS — nav fontFamily is inherit, always available
